BranchSettings.title: BranchSettings
BranchSettings.description: Default global branch network IP lock, shift timing, break limit, and daily work hours configuration.

allowedIp.description: Allowed branch public IP address, or empty string for open trial mode.

shiftStart.description: Default branch shift start time in HH:MM 24h format.

graceMinutes.description: Allowed grace period in minutes after shiftStart before marking late.

maxBreakMinutes.description: Maximum allowed break duration in minutes per shift before flagging an overage warning.

targetDailyHours.description: Expected net working hours per day for overtime/deficit calculation.

updatedBy.description: User ID of the admin who updated the settings.

Branch.title: Branch
Branch.description: Branch configuration including network IP lock, GPS geofence, break/work hours policy, and defined shifts.

allowedIp.description: Optional branch public IP address for network lock.

geoEnabled.description: Whether GPS geofencing is enforced for this branch.

radiusMeters.description: Allowed GPS radius in meters around the branch.

shiftStart.description: Default shift start time in HH:MM format for this branch.

graceMinutes.description: Grace minutes for late arrival at this branch.

maxBreakMinutes.description: Maximum allowed break duration in minutes at this branch.

targetDailyHours.description: Target net daily working hours at this branch.

shifts.description: List of shifts configured for this branch.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when branch was created.

updatedBy.description: User ID of the admin who updated the branch.

AdminSecret.title: AdminSecret
AdminSecret.description: Admin panel secondary kiosk lock passcode hash.

passcodeHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the admin passcode.

lockEnabled.description: Whether the secondary passcode lock is enabled on the admin panel.

updatedBy.description: ID of the admin who updated the secret.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Explicitly granted admin role document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: Verified email of the admin user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin role was granted.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who granted the role.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Employee profile, branch and shift assignment, hashed PIN, current shift status, bound device identifier, and optional HR overrides.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hash of employeeId and PIN.

deviceId.description: Bound browser/mobile device UUID, or null when unbound.

branchId.description: Assigned branch document ID, or null.

branchName.description: Snapshot name of the assigned branch, or null.

shiftId.description: Assigned shift ID within the branch, or null.

shiftName.description: Snapshot name of the assigned shift, or null.

lastCheckIn.description: Epoch milliseconds of latest check-in, or null.

lastCheckOut.description: Epoch milliseconds of latest check-out, or null.

lastBreakStart.description: Epoch milliseconds when current break started, or null.

totalBreakMs.description: Accumulated break duration in milliseconds for current shift.

shiftStart.description: Optional employee-specific shift start HH:MM override, or null.

shiftEnd.description: Optional employee-specific shift end HH:MM override, or null.

graceMinutes.description: Optional employee-specific grace minutes override, or null.

maxBreakMinutes.description: Optional employee-specific max break minutes override, or null.

targetDailyHours.description: Optional employee-specific target daily working hours, or null.

hourlyRate.description: Optional hourly rate for estimated salary calculation in reports, or null.

isActive.description: Whether the employee is active in the kiosk directory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when employee was created.

AttendanceLog.title: AttendanceLog
AttendanceLog.description: Immutable audit log entry for check-in, break, and check-out actions, including manager-approved missed punch adjustments.

employeeName.description: Snapshot name of the employee at action time.

ip.description: Detected client public IP at action time.

deviceId.description: Unique device fingerprint from client or manual_adjustment.

createdByUid.description: Session user ID who recorded the action.

manualRequestId.description: Optional approved attendance_requests document ID when adding a forgotten punch.

branchId.description: Optional branch document ID snapshot at punch time.

branchName.description: Optional branch name snapshot at punch time.

distanceMeters.description: Optional GPS distance in meters from the branch center at punch time.

allowedRadiusMeters.description: Optional configured branch geofence radius in meters.

geoAccuracyMeters.description: Optional GPS horizontal accuracy in meters.

employeeCoords.description: Optional employee GPS coordinates at punch time.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp of the attendance event (or approved missed punch time).

BreakRequest.title: BreakRequest
BreakRequest.description: Employee break permission request requiring manager approval and notification delivery.

employeeId.description: Document ID of the employee requesting a break.

employeeName.description: Name of the employee requesting a break.

reason.description: Optional reason for the break request.

status.description: Approval lifecycle state of the break request.

requestedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

reviewedAt.description: Server timestamp when the manager approved or rejected the request, or null.

reviewedBy.description: Name of the manager who reviewed the request, or null.

notified.description: Whether the employee acknowledged the approval/rejection notification.

AttendanceRequest.title: AttendanceRequest
AttendanceRequest.description: Employee request for missed check-in/out correction, late/early-leave permission, or leave.

employeeId.description: Document ID of the employee submitting the request.

employeeName.description: Name of the employee submitting the request.

type.description: Category of attendance, permission, or leave request.

targetTime.description: Target time (HH:MM) or empty string for full-day leave.

targetTimestampMs.description: Target epoch milliseconds for missed punch requests, or null.

reason.description: Reason or justification provided by the employee.

reviewedAt.description: Server timestamp when reviewed, or null.

reviewedBy.description: Name of reviewing manager, or null.

notified.description: Whether the employee acknowledged the decision notification.

/settings/branch.description: Singleton branch IP lock and HR policy defaults document.

/branches/{branchId}.description: Multi-branch configurations with IP, GPS geofence, break/work hours, and shifts.

/settings/admin_secret.description: Singleton admin passcode hash document isolated from non-admins.

/employees/{employeeId}.description: Active and archived employees with branch/shift assignments, hashed PINs, and bound device IDs.

/attendance_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable chronological attendance and break events.

/break_requests/{requestId}.description: Real-time employee break permission requests and manager approval statuses.

/attendance_requests/{requestId}.description: Employee missed-punch, excuse/permission, and leave requests.
